controls: Both arms open/consume the same bytes twice, same machine/compiler/held files, explicit first/second replacement checks, registered clean raw BLAKE3.

modeled_arms.copy: One raw BLAKE3 leaf per generated file in a domain-separated prospective tree, retain immutable heap bytes and compare second read via memcmp; compute actual normal-order digest on mismatch.
modeled_arms.raw: BLAKE3 first tree payload then ordinary raw BLAKE3 second.

preflight: host one-minute load below 2, at least 10 GiB available RAM, all three raw data hashes exact; verify 7,918,933 B, stable true-consecutive output from independently fresh processes, and both directions of actual ZIP changes.
public_primary: descriptive median per arm and all 24 paired differences; if slower or ambiguous, do not build a product.
scope: Native-only cost of two verified observations on three real warm Ruff generated buffers. No Cargo product or whole-build effect inferred.
workload: Fresh process per arm. First both Unicode files then both consumers, followed by ZIP first+second. One CPU 28. Exact reads default 16KiB then 64KiB. Timing includes allocation, first write, comparison, both reads, free.
